title: MWC GHL to-be workflow file
description: One workflow spec that extract-diff will later turn into an unpublished GHL draft in the staging location. Native GHL only; no custom_code, no new Supabase. The Force (consult writer) contract is NOT a workflow and lives in to-be/force.json governed by to-be/force.schema.json.
$comment: Force (mwcforce) is a first-class writer contract, not a workflow, so it does not use this schema. See to-be/force.json + to-be/force.schema.json. Native GHL workflows still validate here (wf-01..wf-17); Force UPDATES the Sales opportunity via the public GHL API and then POSTs GHL_WF05_WEBHOOK_URL so native WF-05 routes.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the trigger (blockers, dependencies).

named_steps.description: Ordered list of named steps. Each step is TYPE: Purpose (qualifier) plus a one-line comment.

name.description: TYPE: Purpose (qualifier). TYPE is upper-case, colon, space, then human text.

comment.description: Why the step exists and what it must not write.

writes.description: Optional explicit list of fields/tags this step writes.

does_not_write.description: Optional explicit list of fields/tags this step must not write.

tags_new.description: New v2_* tags this workflow is allowed to write.

live_tags_readonly.description: Live tags the workflow may read or branch on but must never rename or remove.
